message.content: Clean annual series FY2019–FY2025 (fiscal years ending Jan 31). Now let me compute margins.

I have the disclosed annual figures; I'll compute the remaining margins by hand from those values.

**Snowflake Inc. (CIK 1640147) — profitability trend, fiscal years ending Jan 31 (FY2019–FY2025)**

All figures are consolidated annual values from 10-K filings (latest applicable disclosure, accession 0001640147-25-000052 for FY2023–FY2025; earlier years from prior 10-Ks). Revenue = RevenueFromContractWithCustomerExcludingAssessedTax; profit = NetIncomeLoss (net loss attributable to the company) and OperatingIncomeLoss.

| FY (end Jan 31) | Revenue ($) | Gross profit ($) | Gross margin | Operating income ($) | Operating margin | Net loss ($) | Net margin |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 2019 | 96,666,000 | 44,913,000 | 46.5% | -185,465,000 | -191.9% | -178,028,000 | -184.2% |
| 2020 | 264,748,000 | 148,191,000 | 56.0% | -358,088,000 | -135.3% | -348,535,000 | -131.6% |
| 2021 | 592,049,000 | 349,461,000 | 59.0% | -543,937,000 | -91.9% | -539,102,000 | -91.1% |
| 2022 | 1,219,327,000 | 760,894,000 | 62.4% | -715,036,000 | -58.6% | -679,948,000 | -55.8% |
| 2023 | 2,065,659,000 | 1,348,119,000 | 65.3% | -842,267,000 | -40.8% | -796,705,000 | -38.6% |
| 2024 | 2,806,489,000 | 1,907,931,000 | 68.0% | -1,094,773,000 | -39.0% | -836,097,000 | -29.8% |
| 2025 | 3,626,396,000 | 2,411,723,000 | 66.5% | -1,456,010,000 | -40.2% | -1,285,640,000 | -35.5% |

(Margins are derived: gross profit/revenue, operating income/revenue, net loss/revenue. Gross margins for all years and the FY2019 operating margin were computed with the calculator; the remaining ratios were computed by hand from the disclosed dollar values above.)

**Interpretation**
- **Gross profitability improved steadily** from 46.5% in FY2019 to a peak of 68.0% in FY2024, then slipped to 66.5% in FY2025 — still far above early years.
- **Operating losses widened in absolute dollars every year** (from -$185M to -$1.46B), but as a share of revenue the operating margin improved sharply from -191.9% (FY2019) to about -40% (FY2023–FY2025), i.e., losses grew more slowly than revenue until FY2024–FY2025, when the operating margin roughly stabilized around -39% to -40%.
- **Net loss also widened in dollars** (to -$1.29B in FY2025) while net margin improved from -184% to about -30% to -36%; FY2025's net margin worsened versus FY2024 (-29.8% → -35.5%), so the bottom line deteriorated in the latest year even as gross margin stayed high.

**Limitations:** These are GAAP figures; Snowflake reports large stock-based compensation and other items, so non-GAAP profitability is not reflected here. The database does not provide complete start_date information, but the annual frames (CY2018–CY2024) and 10-K form types confirm these are full-year periods ending January 31. No quarterly figures were mixed in, and duplicate comparative disclosures were not summed.
